reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding: enforce_post_borrow_repay_invariant is NOT called). Gate 2 passes (no trust_assumptions in scope; attacker is an external liquidator). Gate 3 passes (market.move is in_scope; liquidation logic is a focus_area). Code confirmed at L774: unsafe_repay_debt_only is called without enforce_post_borrow_repay_invariant, whereas handle_repay (L470) does call it. An attacker can trigger this via the handle_liquidation entry point by submitting a liquidation with available_repay_coin calibrated so that remaining debt falls between 0 and min_borrow_amount (e.g., debt=150, close_factor=50%, min_borrow_amount=100 => repay 75 => dust debt=75), causing the obligation to enter an invalid sub-min-borrow state that is difficult or uneconomical to subsequently liquidate.
